summary: Physical Android acceptance confirms the unified drawer exposes Channels and Personal tabs, system Back dismisses the drawer, and the members edge gesture remains usable after returning to the workspace.

checks.name: Drawer tabs on physical Android
checks.command: adb shell input tap 89 231; adb shell input tap 617 372; adb shell input tap 233 372; adb shell uiautomator dump /sdcard/codex-window.xml
checks.observation: The opened drawer exposed the 'Каналы' and 'Личные' tabs. Both were reachable and switching between them did not open a DM or join a voice channel. No conversation content or participant identities were collected.

checks.name: Back dismissal and members edge gesture after drawer navigation
checks.command: adb shell input keyevent 4; adb shell input swipe 980 1200 700 1200 250; adb shell input keyevent 4; adb shell dumpsys activity activities
checks.observation: System Back closed the channel drawer. The right-edge swipe then opened the members drawer, confirmed by its close label; Back closed it. ru.boohtacord.app remained the top resumed activity. No voice connection or message action occurred.

remaining: Voice channel entry, switching to a different TEXT channel and returning to a DM, active dock gestures, and iOS physical acceptance remain open in QA-78/QA-79 and the parity checklist.
